summary_of_core_decisions: The essay critiques Craig's arguments by distinguishing logical impossibility from counter-intuitiveness, appeals to Cantorian set theory to show mathematical coherence, and defends LDS eternalism by adopting a B-theory of time and redefining infinity as a continuous ontological continuum rather than a countable set.
